jobType.instructions: Which category describes this vacancy, based on its description and employer requirements? Classify the vacancy itself. Required experience counts; preferred experience does not exclude freshers. Managing interns is not an internship. Management trainee is not automatically an intern. Choose the best supported category.

criteria.Full-time Fresher: Regular full-time employment open to applicants without prior professional experience, including fresh graduates and entry-level trainees.
criteria.Full-time Experienced: Regular full-time employment requiring prior professional experience or established senior or management responsibilities.
criteria.Intern: The vacancy itself is an internship or student intern placement.
criteria.Contract: The vacancy itself is fixed-term, temporary, freelance, or contract employment.
